title: Account service API contracts and event projections
workflow: Authenticate and resolve institution plus account mandate
Validate typed schema and expected aggregate version
Check approval and financial delegation boundaries
Apply account-domain state change atomically with outbox
Publish event with minimal PII and stable schema version
Return safe response with trace and status semantics
invariants: Account service cannot write ledger or settlement database directly
All command retries use stable idempotency keys
API responses must distinguish business success from accepted request
All queries scoped at backend resource level
Events cannot expose unrestricted KYC data
Read projections record freshness and source version
planned_tests: Duplicate account-opening command yields one account
No financial journal from status-only event
approval_gate: Approved API/role contracts, customer privacy review and executable integration tests.
